description: Create or verify checksums using the fast non-cryptographic xxHash algorithm.

tip: Read from stdin even if it is a console.
Treat all following arguments as file names.

option.name: --benchmark-all
tip: Benchmark every algorithm variant.
Not listed in --help.

option.name: --binary
tip: Read files in binary mode.
Accepted for compatibility; xxhsum always reads files in binary mode.

option.name: --check
tip: Read xxHash checksums from the file arguments and verify them.

option.name: --files-from
tip: Read filenames from the file arguments and generate hashes for them.
Each list file holds one filename per line.
Use - to read the list from stdin.

option.name: --ignore-missing
tip: Do not fail or report status for missing files.

option.name: --little-endian
tip: Display checksum values in little-endian convention.
Default: big endian.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not print OK for each successfully verified checksum.
In benchmark mode, do not display the version header.

option.name: --seed
tip: Set the unsigned decimal seed used for hashing and checksum verification.
The seed is not stored in checksum files, so verification needs the same value.
Default: 0.

option.name: --status
tip: Output nothing; the exit status shows success.

option.name: --strict
tip: Return a non-zero exit status if any line in the checksum files is improperly formatted.

option.name: --tag
tip: Produce BSD-style checksum lines.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --warn
tip: Warn about each improperly formatted line in the checksum files.

option.name: -b
tip: Run benchmark mode.
Append variant IDs to benchmark only those variants, e.g. -b1,2,3.

option.name: -B
tip: Set the block size, in bytes, to hash per benchmark iteration.
The value must be attached, e.g. -B16384.
Accepts K, KB, KiB, M, MB and MiB suffixes, all powers of 1024.
Default: 102400 B.

option.name: -H
tip: Select the xxHash algorithm.
The value must be attached, e.g. -H0.
Default: 1 (XXH64); xxh32sum defaults to 0, xxh128sum to 2, and xxh3sum to 3.
XXH128 (also called XXH3_128bits)
XXH3 (also called XXH3_64bits)
XXH32
XXH64

option.name: -i
tip: Set the number of benchmark iterations.
A single iteration lasts about 1000 milliseconds.
The value must be attached, e.g. -i10.
Default: 3.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display the help page, including advanced options.
